script:
--========================================================
-- RSR STUDIO - SHOOTER PANEL ENHANCED
-- ONE LOCAL SCRIPT
-- Existing tabs preserved: PVP / MOVEMENT / SETTINGS
-- Added: BETTER FPS + INFORMATION + INVISIBLE (LOCAL)
--========================================================

-- SERVICES
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

--========================================================
-- SETTINGS
--========================================================

local Settings = {
    OpenKey = Enum.KeyCode.K,

    -- PVP
    AimAssist = false,
    AimKey = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,
    AimKeyName = "RIGHT MOUSE",
    ESP = false,
    Tracers = false,
    FOVEnabled = true,
    FOV = 120,
    AimSmoothness = 0.15,
    Hitbox = 0,

    -- MOVEMENT
    SpeedEnabled = false,
    Speed = 16,
    FlyEnabled = false,
    FlySpeed = 50,
    SpinEnabled = false,
    SpinSpeed = 5,

    -- CAMERA / FIRST PERSON
    CameraFOV = 120,
    ArmsEnabled = false,
    ArmDistance = 0,

    -- VISUALS
    RainEnabled = true,
    MirrorEnabled = true,
    NeonAnimations = true,

    -- BETTER FPS
    BetterFPSEnabled = false,

    -- INVISIBILITY
    Invisible = false,

    -- COLORS
    ESPColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
    TracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    FOVColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),

    GuiOpen = true,
    SoundsEnabled = true,
}

-- Roblox's native Camera.FieldOfView cannot exceed 120 degrees.
local NATIVE_FOV_MAX = 120

--========================================================
-- UI SOUNDS + PRESS ANIMATION
-- Change the Id values below to any sound you like,
-- e.g. "rbxassetid://123456789"
--========================================================

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local SoundIDs = {
    Click = {Id = "rbxasset://sounds/button.wav", Volume = 0.6},
    Toggle = {Id = "rbxasset://sounds/switch.wav", Volume = 0.6},
}

local function PlaySound(Name)
    if not Settings.SoundsEnabled then
        return
    end

    local Data = SoundIDs[Name]
    if not Data then
        return
    end

    local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    Sound.SoundId = Data.Id
    Sound.Volume = Data.Volume
    Sound.Parent = SoundService
    Sound:Play()

    task.delay(3, function()
        if Sound then
            Sound:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

-- Button shrinks when pressed, springs back on release, plays a click sound.
local function AddPressAnimation(Button, SoundName)
    local Scale = Button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or Instance.new("UIScale")
    Scale.Scale = 1
    Scale.Parent = Button

    Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(
            Scale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.07, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Scale = 0.94}
        ):Play()
    end)

    local function Release()
        TweenService:Create(
            Scale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Scale = 1}
        ):Play()
    end

    Button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(Release)
    Button.MouseLeave:Connect(Release)

    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        PlaySound(SoundName or "Click")
    end)
end

--========================================================
-- GUI ROOT
--========================================================

local Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
Gui.Name = "RSR_Studio_Shooter"
Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
Gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
Gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
Gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--========================================================
-- MAIN WINDOW
--========================================================

local Main = Instance.new("Frame")
Main.Name = "Main"
Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 800, 0, 540)
Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -400, 0.5, -270)
Main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(7, 9, 14)
Main.BorderSizePixel = 0
Main.ClipsDescendants = true
Main.ZIndex = 5
Main.Parent = Gui

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 26)
MainCorner.Parent = Main

local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 105, 145)
MainStroke.Thickness = 1.5
MainStroke.Transparency = 0.1
MainStroke.Parent = Main

local MainGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
MainGradient.Rotation = 35
MainGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(8, 11, 20)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(11, 13, 21)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(5, 8, 13)),
})
MainGradient.Parent = Main

local MainScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
MainScale.Scale = 1
MainScale.Parent = Main

--========================================================
-- NEON BRAND / REFLECTION
--========================================================

local Reflection = Instance.new("Frame")
Reflection.Name = "ReflectionSweep"
Reflection.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 1.6, 0)
Reflection.Position = UDim2.new(-0.2, 0, -0.3, 0)
Reflection.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Reflection.BackgroundTransparency = 0.94
Reflection.BorderSizePixel = 0
Reflection.Rotation = 18
Reflection.ZIndex = 8
Reflection.Parent = Main

local ReflectionGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
ReflectionGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, 0.85),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.2),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 0.85),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
})
ReflectionGradient.Parent = Reflection

local GlassGlow = Instance.new("Frame")
GlassGlow.Name = "GlassGlow"
GlassGlow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -12)
GlassGlow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6)
GlassGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
GlassGlow.BorderSizePixel = 0
GlassGlow.ZIndex = 7
GlassGlow.Parent = Main

local GlassStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
GlassStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 210, 255)
GlassStroke.Thickness = 1
GlassStroke.Transparency = 0.72
GlassStroke.Parent = GlassGlow

local GlassCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
GlassCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 17)
GlassCorner.Parent = GlassGlow

--========================================================
-- EXTRA NEON / RTX-STYLE GUI FX
--========================================================

local NeonGlows = {}
for i, data in ipairs({
    {size = 2, transparency = 0.52},
    {size = 4, transparency = 0.70},
    {size = 7, transparency = 0.84},
    {size = 11, transparency = 0.92},
    {size = 16, transparency = 0.965},
}) do
    local Glow = Main:Clone()
    Glow.Name = "NeonGlow_" .. i
    Glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Glow.ClipsDescendants = true
    Glow.Position = UDim2.new(0, -data.size, 0, -data.size)
    Glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, data.size * 2, 1, data.size * 2)
    Glow.ZIndex = 3

    for _, child in ipairs(Glow:GetChildren()) do
        child:Destroy()
    end

    local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    Stroke.Thickness = data.size
    Stroke.Transparency = data.transparency
    Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 245, 255)
    Stroke.Parent = Glow

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 26 + data.size)
    Corner.Parent = Glow
    Glow.Parent = Main
    table.insert(NeonGlows, Stroke)
end

local RTXLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
RTXLabel.Name = "RTXStyle"
RTXLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 22)
RTXLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -105, 0, 20)
RTXLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
RTXLabel.Text = "RTX STYLE"
RTXLabel.TextSize = 10
RTXLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
RTXLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 245)
RTXLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
RTXLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 130, 255)
RTXLabel.ZIndex = 16
RTXLabel.Parent = Main

local NeonTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
NeonTitle.Name = "NeonRSRTitle"
NeonTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 40)
NeonTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -250, 0, 3)
NeonTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
NeonTitle.Text = "RSR SCRIPT STUDIO"
NeonTitle.TextSize = 28
NeonTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
NeonTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
NeonTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 248)
NeonTitle.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.04
NeonTitle.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 125, 255)
NeonTitle.ZIndex = 17
NeonTitle.Parent = Main

local NeonTitleGlow = NeonTitle:Clone()
NeonTitleGlow.Name = "NeonRSRTitleGlow"
NeonTitleGlow.TextTransparency = 0.65
NeonTitleGlow.ZIndex = 16
NeonTitleGlow.Parent = Main

-- Neon bushes / vines in every corner.
local BushLayer = Instance.new("Frame")
BushLayer.Name = "RTXCornerBushes"
BushLayer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
BushLayer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
BushLayer.ZIndex = 13
BushLayer.Parent = Main

local Bushes = {}
local function CreateBushCorner(xScale, yScale, flipX, flipY)
    local Holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    Holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(145, 115)
    Holder.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, flipX and -116 or -4, yScale, flipY and -91 or -4)
    Holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Holder.ZIndex = 13
    Holder.Parent = BushLayer

    local BaseGlow = Instance.new("Frame")
    BaseGlow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(118, 82)
    BaseGlow.Position = UDim2.new(0, flipX and 20 or 6, 0, flipY and 27 or 6)
    BaseGlow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 255, 220)
    BaseGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.91
    BaseGlow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    BaseGlow.ZIndex = 13
    BaseGlow.Parent = Holder
    local bc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    bc.Parent = BaseGlow

    for i = 1, 40 do
        local Leaf = Instance.new("Frame")
        local px = (i % 5) * 18 + math.random(-5, 5)
        local py = math.floor((i - 1) / 5) * 20 + math.random(-5, 5)
        Leaf.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(16, 38), math.random(12, 30))
        Leaf.Position = UDim2.new(0, flipX and (88-px) or px, 0, flipY and (70-py) or py)
        Leaf.Rotation = math.random(-55, 55)
        Leaf.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10 + math.random(0, 35), 110 + math.random(0, 120), 70 + math.random(0, 150))
        Leaf.BackgroundTransparency = math.random(28, 55) / 100
        Leaf.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Leaf.ZIndex = 14
        Leaf.Parent = Holder
        local lc = Instance.new("UICorner")
        lc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        lc.Parent = Leaf
        local ls = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        ls.Thickness = math.random(1, 2)
        ls.Transparency = 0.32
        ls.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 255, 230)
        ls.Parent = Leaf
        table.insert(Bushes, {part = Leaf, base = Leaf.Rotation, phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2})
    end
end

CreateBushCorner(0, 0, false, false)
CreateBushCorner(1, 0, true, false)
CreateBushCorner(0, 1, false, true)
CreateBushCorner(1, 1, true, true)

local CornerRays = {}
for corner = 1, 4 do
    for ray = 1, 6 do
        local Beam = Instance.new("Frame")
        Beam.Name = "RTX_CornerRay_" .. corner .. "_" .. ray
        Beam.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(30, 75), math.random(1, 3))
        Beam.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 255, 240)
        Beam.BackgroundTransparency = 0.68
        Beam.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Beam.ZIndex = 12
        Beam.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        Beam.Rotation = ((corner == 2 or corner == 4) and -1 or 1) * math.random(18, 48)
        local x = (corner == 2 or corner == 4) and 1 or 0
        local y = (corner >= 3) and 1 or 0
        Beam.Position = UDim2.new(x, x == 1 and -28 or 28, y, y == 1 and -28 or 28)
        Beam.Parent = BushLayer
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        c.Parent = Beam
        table.insert(CornerRays, {part = Beam, phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2})
    end
end

-- Small reflective strips for a glass / ray-traced look.
for i = 1, 8 do
    local Strip = Instance.new("Frame")
    Strip.Name = "RTXReflectiveStrip" .. i
    Strip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70 + i * 10, 0, 1)
    Strip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20 + (i - 1) * 15, 1, -18 - (i - 1) * 4)
    Strip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 245, 255)
    Strip.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
    Strip.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Strip.Rotation = -5
    Strip.ZIndex = 14
    Strip.Parent = Main
end

--========================================================
-- RAIN OVERLAY
--========================================================

local Rain = Instance.new("Frame")
Rain.Name = "Rain"
Rain.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
Rain.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Rain.ClipsDescendants = true
Rain.ZIndex = 4
Rain.Parent = Main

local function CreateRainDrop()
    if not Settings.RainEnabled or not Rain.Parent then
        return
    end

    local Drop = Instance.new("Frame")
    Drop.Name = "Drop"

    local height = math.random(18, 48)
    local width = math.random(1, 2)

    Drop.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
    Drop.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(-10, 110) / 100, 0, -0.1, 0)
    Drop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 175, 255)
    Drop.BackgroundTransparency = math.random(35, 72) / 100
    Drop.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Drop.Rotation = math.random(-8, 8)
    Drop.ZIndex = 4
    Drop.Parent = Rain

    local DropCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    DropCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    DropCorner.Parent = Drop

    local duration = math.random(55, 120) / 100
    local xShift = math.random(-25, 25) / 1000

    TweenService:Create(
        Drop,
        TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
        {
            Position = UDim2.new(
                Drop.Position.X.Scale + xShift,
                0,
                1.2,
                0
            ),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.94,
        }
    ):Play()

    task.delay(duration, function()
        if Drop then
            Drop:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    while Gui.Parent do
        if Settings.RainEnabled then
            for _ = 1, 2 do
                CreateRainDrop()
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.045)
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- DECORATIVE BACKGROUND / CURVATURE
--========================================================

local AccentTop = Instance.new("Frame")
AccentTop.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 2)
AccentTop.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 70)
AccentTop.BorderSizePixel = 0
AccentTop.ZIndex = 14
AccentTop.Parent = Main

local AccentGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
AccentGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 230)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(95, 140, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 210)),
})
AccentGradient.Parent = AccentTop

local AccentCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
AccentCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
AccentCorner.Parent = AccentTop

--========================================================
-- SUBTITLE
--========================================================

local SubTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SubTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 450, 0, 25)
SubTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 27, 0, 52)
SubTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SubTitle.Text = "DEVELOPER CONTROL PANEL"
SubTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 120, 140)
SubTitle.TextSize = 11
SubTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
SubTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
SubTitle.ZIndex = 14
SubTitle.Parent = Main

--========================================================
-- SIDEBAR / CONTENT
--========================================================

local Sidebar = Instance.new("Frame")
Sidebar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 185, 1, -105)
Sidebar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 92)
Sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 15, 22)
Sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
Sidebar.BorderSizePixel = 0
Sidebar.ZIndex = 10
Sidebar.Parent = Main

local SidebarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SidebarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
SidebarCorner.Parent = Sidebar

local SidebarStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
SidebarStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 75, 105)
SidebarStroke.Transparency = 0.4
SidebarStroke.Parent = Sidebar

local Content = Instance.new("Frame")
Content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -220, 1, -105)
Content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 205, 0, 92)
Content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Content.ZIndex = 10
Content.Parent = Main

--========================================================
-- TABS (ORIGINAL TABS KEPT)
--========================================================

local Tabs = {}
local Pages = {}

local function CreateTab(Name, Text, Order)
    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Button.Name = Name
    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 45)
    Button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10 + (Order - 1) * 55)
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 34)
    Button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Button.Text = Text
    Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 180)
    Button.TextSize = 13
    Button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    Button.ZIndex = 12
    Button.AutoButtonColor = false
    Button.Parent = Sidebar

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    Corner.Parent = Button

    local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 85, 120)
    Stroke.Transparency = 0.75
    Stroke.Parent = Button

    Tabs[Name] = Button
    AddPressAnimation(Button, "Click")

    Button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if Button.BackgroundColor3 ~= Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 90) then
            TweenService:Create(
                Button,
                TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(33, 39, 55)}
            ):Play()
        end
    end)

    Button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if Button.BackgroundColor3 ~= Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 90) then
            TweenService:Create(
                Button,
                TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 34)}
            ):Play()
        end
    end)

    return Button
end

local function CreatePage(Name)
    local Page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    Page.Name = Name
    Page.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    Page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Page.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    Page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 90, 120)
    Page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1000)
    Page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    Page.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
    Page.Visible = false
    Page.ZIndex = 11
    Page.Parent = Content

    Pages[Name] = Page
    return Page
end

-- Existing tabs
CreateTab("PVP", "PVP", 1)
CreateTab("MOVEMENT", "MOVEMENT", 2)
CreateTab("SETTINGS", "SETTINGS", 3)
-- New tab
CreateTab("BETTERFPS", "BETTER FPS", 4)
CreateTab("INFO", "INFORMATION", 5)

local PVP = CreatePage("PVP")
local Movement = CreatePage("MOVEMENT")
local SettingsPage = CreatePage("SETTINGS")
local BetterFPS = CreatePage("BETTERFPS")
local InfoPage = CreatePage("INFO")

local function SwitchPage(Name)
    for PageName, Page in pairs(Pages) do
        local Show = PageName == Name
        if Show and not Page.Visible then
            Page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
            Page.Visible = true
            TweenService:Create(
                Page,
                TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)}
            ):Play()
        else
            Page.Visible = Show
        end
    end

    for TabName, Button in pairs(Tabs) do
        local Selected = TabName == Name
        TweenService:Create(
            Button,
            TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {
                BackgroundColor3 = Selected
                    and Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 90)
                    or Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 34),
                TextColor3 = Selected
                    and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    or Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 180),
            }
        ):Play()
    end
end

for Name, Button in pairs(Tabs) do
    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        SwitchPage(Name)
    end)
end

SwitchPage("PVP")

--========================================================
-- UI HELPERS
--========================================================

local function CreateSection(Page, Text, Y)
    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, Y)
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Text = Text
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 150, 255)
    Label.TextSize = 12
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.ZIndex = 12
    Label.Parent = Page
    return Label
end

local function CreateToggle(Page, Text, Y, Default, Callback)
    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 42)
    Button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, Y)
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 31)
    Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Button.Text = ""
    Button.ZIndex = 12
    Button.AutoButtonColor = false
    Button.Parent = Page

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    Corner.Parent = Button

    local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(62, 73, 97)
    Stroke.Transparency = 0.68
    Stroke.Parent = Button

    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -65, 1, 0)
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Text = Text
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 223, 230)
    Label.TextSize = 13
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.ZIndex = 13
    Label.Parent = Button

    local Status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Status.Size = UDim2.new(0, 45, 1, 0)
    Status.Position = UDim2.new(1, -55, 0, 0)
    Status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Status.TextSize = 11
    Status.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    Status.ZIndex = 13
    Status.Parent = Button

    local State = Default

    local StatusScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    StatusScale.Parent = Status

    local function Update(Animate)
        Status.Text = State and "ON" or "OFF"
        Status.TextColor3 = State
            and Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 150)
            or Color3.fromRGB(120, 125, 135)

        local TargetColor = State
            and Color3.fromRGB(25, 38, 38)
            or Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 31)

        if Animate then
            TweenService:Create(
                Button,
                TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {BackgroundColor3 = TargetColor}
            ):Play()

            StatusScale.Scale = 1.6
            TweenService:Create(
                StatusScale,

local function GetClosestTarget()
    local Closest = nil
    local ClosestDistance = math.huge

    local Center = Vector2.new(
        Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
        Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2
    )

    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local Character = Player.Character
            local Head = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if Head and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local Position, Visible = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)

                if Visible and Position.Z > 0 then
                    local ScreenPosition = Vector2.new(Position.X, Position.Y)
                    local Distance = (ScreenPosition - Center).Magnitude

                    if Distance <= Settings.FOV and Distance < ClosestDistance then
                        ClosestDistance = Distance
                        Closest = Head
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return Closest
end

local FlyVelocity

local function StartFly()
    if FlyConnection then
        FlyConnection:Disconnect()
        FlyConnection = nil
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Root = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not Root then
        return
    end

    if FlyVelocity then
        FlyVelocity:Destroy()
    end

    FlyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    FlyVelocity.Name = "RSR_FlyVelocity"
    FlyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    FlyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    FlyVelocity.Parent = Root

    FlyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Settings.FlyEnabled or not Root.Parent then
            return
        end

        local Direction = Vector3.zero

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            Direction += Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            Direction -= Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            Direction -= Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            Direction += Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            Direction += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            Direction -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        if Direction.Magnitude > 0 then
            Direction = Direction.Unit
        end

        FlyVelocity.Velocity = Direction * Settings.FlySpeed
    end)
end

local function StopFly()
    if FlyConnection then
        FlyConnection:Disconnect()
        FlyConnection = nil
    end

    if FlyVelocity then
        FlyVelocity:Destroy()
        FlyVelocity = nil
    end
end

local function UpdateHeadHitbox(Player)
    if Player == LocalPlayer then

-- FIRST PERSON ARM DISTANCE
--========================================================

local ArmJointCache = {}

local function GetArmJoints(Character)
    local Joints = {}

    local UpperTorso = Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    if UpperTorso then
        local Left = UpperTorso:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder")
        local Right = UpperTorso:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder")
        if Left and Left:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Left)
        end
        if Right and Right:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Right)
        end
    end

    local Torso = Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if Torso then
        local Left = Torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder")
        local Right = Torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder")
        if Left and Left:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Left)
        end
        if Right and Right:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Right)
        end
    end

    return Joints
end

local function IsFirstPerson()
    if not Camera then
        return false
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local Head = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not Head then
        return false
    end

    return (Camera.CFrame.Position - Head.Position).Magnitude < 1.1
end

local function UpdateArmDistance()
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Joints = ArmJointCache[Character]
    if not Joints then
        Joints = GetArmJoints(Character)
        ArmJointCache[Character] = Joints
    end

    local Active = Settings.ArmsEnabled and IsFirstPerson()

    for _, Joint in ipairs(Joints) do
        if Joint.Parent then
            if not Joint:GetAttribute("RSR_OriginalCached") then
                Joint:SetAttribute("RSR_OriginalCached", true)
                Joint:SetAttribute("RSR_OriginalC0", tostring(Joint.C0))
            end

            -- Use a local Transform for a safer visual offset during first-person.
            if Active then
                local direction = Joint.Name:lower():find("left") and -1 or 1
                Joint.Transform = CFrame.new(direction * Settings.ArmDistance * 0.18, 0, -Settings.ArmDistance * 0.08)
            else
                Joint.Transform = CFrame.identity
            end
        end
    end
end

--========================================================
-- INVISIBILITY
--========================================================

local InvisibleOriginals = {}

local function RememberInvisible(instance, property)
    InvisibleOriginals[instance] = InvisibleOriginals[instance] or {}
    if InvisibleOriginals[instance][property] == nil then
        local ok, value = pcall(function() return instance[property] end)
        if ok then
            InvisibleOriginals[instance][property] = value
        end
    end
end

local function ApplyInvisibleToCharacter(character)
    if not character then return end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            RememberInvisible(descendant, "LocalTransparencyModifier")
            pcall(function() descendant.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end)
        elseif descendant:IsA("Decal") or descendant:IsA("Texture") then
            RememberInvisible(descendant, "Transparency")
            pcall(function() descendant.Transparency = 1 end)
        end
    end
end

local function RemoveInvisibleFromCharacter(character)
    for instance, properties in pairs(InvisibleOriginals) do
        if instance and instance.Parent then
            for property, value in pairs(properties) do
                pcall(function() instance[property] = value end)
            end
        end
    end
    InvisibleOriginals = {}
end

local function UpdateInvisibility()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if Settings.Invisible then
        ApplyInvisibleToCharacter(character)
    else
        RemoveInvisibleFromCharacter(character)
    end
end

--========================================================
-- BETTER FPS OPTIMIZER
--========================================================

local FPSOriginals = {}
local FPSDescendantConnection
local FPSLightingOriginals = {
    GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
}

local function RememberProperty(Instance, Property)
    FPSOriginals[Instance] = FPSOriginals[Instance] or {}
    if FPSOriginals[Instance][Property] == nil then
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return Instance[Property]
        end)
        if ok then
            FPSOriginals[Instance][Property] = value
        end
    end
end

local function OptimizeInstance(Instance)
    if not Settings.BetterFPSEnabled then
        return
    end

    if Instance:IsA("Decal") or Instance:IsA("Texture") then
        RememberProperty(Instance, "Transparency")
        pcall(function()
            Instance.Transparency = 1
        end)
    elseif Instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or Instance:IsA("Trail") or Instance:IsA("Beam")
        or Instance:IsA("Smoke") or Instance:IsA("Fire") or Instance:IsA("Sparkles") then
        RememberProperty(Instance, "Enabled")
        pcall(function()
            Instance.Enabled = false
        end)
    elseif Instance:IsA("BloomEffect") or Instance:IsA("SunRaysEffect")
        or Instance:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or Instance:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect")
        or Instance:IsA("BlurEffect") then
        RememberProperty(Instance, "Enabled")
        pcall(function()
            Instance.Enabled = false
        end)
    end
end

local function EnableBetterFPS()
    Settings.BetterFPSEnabled = true
    FPSLightingOriginals.GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = false

    for _, Descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        OptimizeInstance(Descendant)
    end

    for _, Descendant in ipairs(Lighting:GetDescendants()) do
        OptimizeInstance(Descendant)
    end

    if FPSDescendantConnection then
        FPSDescendantConnection:Disconnect()
    end

    FPSDescendantConnection = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(Instance)
        task.defer(function()
            OptimizeInstance(Instance)
        end)
    end)
end

local function DisableBetterFPS()
    Settings.BetterFPSEnabled = false

    if FPSDescendantConnection then
        FPSDescendantConnection:Disconnect()
        FPSDescendantConnection = nil
    end

    for Instance, Properties in pairs(FPSOriginals) do
        if Instance and Instance.Parent then
            for Property, Value in pairs(Properties) do
                pcall(function()
                    Instance[Property] = Value
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    FPSOriginals = {}
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = FPSLightingOriginals.GlobalShadows
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera

    -- FOV circle
    FOVCircle.Visible = Settings.FOVEnabled
    if Settings.FOVEnabled then
        FOVCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Settings.FOV * 2, Settings.FOV * 2)
        FOVStroke.Color = Settings.FOVColor
        FOVGlow.Color = Settings.FOVColor
    end

    -- Neon / mirror animation
    if Settings.NeonAnimations then
        local Pulse = (math.sin(os.clock() * 3) + 1) / 2
        GlassStroke.Transparency = 0.58 + Pulse * 0.2
    else
        GlassStroke.Transparency = 0.72
    end

    Reflection.Visible = Settings.MirrorEnabled
    if Settings.MirrorEnabled and Settings.NeonAnimations then
        local sweep = (os.clock() % 2.8) / 2.8
        Reflection.Position = UDim2.new(-0.35 + sweep * 1.55, 0, -0.25, 0)
    end

    -- ESP: stays active after respawns while ON
    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            if Settings.ESP then
                if not ESPObjects[Player] then
                    CreateESP(Player)
                else
                    local Object = ESPObjects[Player]

                    if Object.Highlight and Object.Highlight.Parent then
                        Object.Highlight.FillColor = Settings.ESPColor
                        Object.Highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
                    end

                    if Object.Billboard and Object.Billboard.Parent then
                        local Label = Object.Billboard:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
                        if Label then
                            Label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                if ESPObjects[Player] then
                    RemoveESP(Player)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Tracers
    for Player, Line in pairs(Tracers) do
        if Line and Line.Parent then
            if not Settings.Tracers then
                Line.Visible = false
            else
                local Character = Player.Character
                local Root = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if Root then
                    local Position, Visible = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Root.Position)
                    if Visible then
                        local Start = Vector2.new(
                            Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
                            Camera.ViewportSize.Y
                        )
                        local Finish = Vector2.new(Position.X, Position.Y)
                        local Difference = Finish - Start
                        local Length = Difference.Magnitude

                        Line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
                            (Start.X + Finish.X) / 2,
                            (Start.Y + Finish.Y) / 2
                        )
                        Line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Length, 2)
                        Line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(Difference.Y, Difference.X))
                        Line.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.TracerColor
                        Line.Visible = true
                    else
                        Line.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    Line.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Speed
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if Humanoid then
        if Settings.SpeedEnabled then
            Humanoid.WalkSpeed = Settings.Speed
        else
            Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        end
    end

    -- Spin
    if Settings.SpinEnabled and Character then
        local Root = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if Root then
            Root.CFrame = Root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Settings.SpinSpeed), 0)
        end
    end

    -- Aim assist
    if Settings.AimAssist then
        local AimPressed = UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Settings.AimKey)
        if AimPressed then
            local Target = GetClosestTarget()
            if Target then
                local CameraPosition = Camera.CFrame.Position
                local TargetCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(CameraPosition, Target.Position)
                Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(TargetCFrame, Settings.AimSmoothness)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Local head visual
    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            UpdateHeadHitbox(Player)
        end
    end

    -- First-person arms
    UpdateArmDistance()
end)
